HOW I BUILD

Engineering is in the details.
So is the experience.

I care about the whole path from a messy problem to a product people can rely on: making the system understandable, getting the fundamentals right, and sweating the details customers actually feel.

01 / DECOMPOSE

Make complexity tractable

Find the right boundaries, turn ambiguity into clear models, and solve the hard parts one deliberate step at a time.

02 / MAKE IT LAST

Build dependable systems

Care about failure modes, performance, and operational simplicity so a system stays understandable as it grows.

03 / MAKE IT MATTER

Make good engineering felt

Listen for customer friction and sweat the interface details that make a powerful product feel clear and effortless.

AI makes more things possible. I’m interested in turning that possibility into systems and product experiences people can trust.

RESEARCH & PUBLICATION

Android malware detection

BROADNETS 2023 / CO-AUTHOR

MalEfficient10%: A Novel Feature Reduction Approach for Android Malware Detection

Co-authored research on reducing Android malware detection features across permissions, intents, and opcodes. The study reduced 724 features to 72 and reported 93.12% average accuracy, with average training time down 91.45% and testing time down 85.25% across 26 classifiers.

With Hemant Rathore, Ajay Kharat, Rashmi T, Sanjay K. Sahay, and Mohit Sewak · Broadband Communications, Networks, and Systems, pp. 72–92.
